request.text: What is the voltage on voltmeter?

solution.item: *** Solution by TINA assisted by AI ***
At first we calculate the total resistance between the generator nodes (Vs)
R2 and R1 connected in series so Ra=R2+R1=30Ohm+20Ohm=50Ohm
Now we calculate the voltage on R2
We know that the voltage between Vs nodes is 100V.
The components R2,R1 connected in series.
The voltage between this components starting and ending node is 100V
R2 is in the voltage divider so the voltage on R2 is R2/Ra*100V = 60V
To answer the original question: because the voltmeter voltmeter connected to R2 parallel so the voltage on voltmeter is 60V
